policy: Master sources are design authority; installed idle anchors export scale/material. Ivory statistics are review flags, not visual acceptance. Boards fit wide/tall poses to cells; interactive viewer preserves runtime pivot and density.

visualReview.method: Four full-resolution identity sources and all seventeen contact boards inspected, covering every selected slot. Timed viewer provided; no new full motion or browser-control acceptance claimed.

findings.finding: Working figures simplify chest, forearm and knee construction, straps and pouches. Side faces are more stylized and contours stronger than master/idle. Exact idle joins expose the detail switch.
findings.next: Restore master suit construction and facial proportions in coherent full poses; preserve case grips and shared joins.

findings.finding: Several intermediate turn poses are brighter and creamier, with rounder panels than endpoints. Loaded swimming shares simplified cargo suit detail.
findings.next: Match interior materials and panel detail to both directional anchors; preserve foreshortening and cargo ownership.

findings.finding: Head and lower boots match idle exactly. Working torso/arms still have broader, smoother panels and less strap/pouch definition. Scanner remains visible.
findings.next: Refine coherent working torso/arm art from masters while retaining protected head/boot pixels.

findings.finding: Identity and overall suit grouping read consistently, but side faces are more stylized and upper-body panel detail less crisp than standing masters.
findings.next: Refine face, collar and torso construction while retaining the alternating authored stride.

findings.finding: Posture explains reduced height. Some faces and rounded knee/forearm panels diverge from the angular master. Supine berth poses change visible facing intentionally; white injury fluid remains white.
findings.next: Refine pose-specific face and suit construction, preserving furniture registration and injury effects.

findings.finding: Recognizable identity/material grouping, with simplified suit detail and foreshortened front faces. Standing silhouettes alone cannot certify horizontal camera poses.
findings.next: Review pose-specific panel/pouch construction after turn and cargo revisions.

findings.finding: Identity and scale stay close to idle, with some smoother working arm/chest detail. Held objects remain readable.
findings.next: Retain body registration and object grip when refining small suit details.

findings.finding: Idle is the export anchor. Conversation and locomotion retain its identity/material/detail closely; welding carries coherent suit construction into work poses. No new defect established by static comparison.
